title: crataegus × grandiflora
intro: Crataegus × grandiflora, commonly known as the White Hawthorn, is a hybrid hawthorn plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of White Hawthorn include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as hypertension, angina, and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of White Hawthorn include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
